key_decisions.decision: Keeps heart language and its relation to the preceding difficult verse.
Follows pinned spoke rather than silently emending to came.
Preserves the clan’s quoted inheritance language and the ember image.
Retains avenger of blood as a biblical term and the exact protective oath image.
Keeps her accusation and reasoning as persuasive speech rather than narrator judgment.
Retains the difficult assertion about God without substituting an alternative text or turning it into doctrine.
Keeps angelic flattery and hearing language without making the king infallible.
Preserves hand and mouth images and her admission of the script.
Unfolds change the face of the matter while keeping extravagant praise in her speech.
Follows read your servant and retains favor-in-eyes language.
Keeps the repeated restriction and incomplete restoration.
Keeps annual timing, reason, amount, and royal standard without modern conversion.
Retains the children without harmonizing the later no-son statement.
